payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to develop per-triple templates, including the transformation of triples into facts using single-triple templates and the use of trivial templates for generating text from RDF triples.

claims.text: Per-triple templates were developed by transforming triples into facts using single-triple templates for each predicate.
The generation of text from RDF triples was done using trivial templates, which were then ordered, aggregated, and compressed.
